newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks revive in early morning following Dow.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks revive in early morning following Dow.

text.p: Tokyo stocks revived in early morning trade on Monday, entering a rebound mode, brokers said.
They said the Nikkei average was being encouraged higher by the U.S. markets, which rose in relief after the U.S. August payroll data was not as strong as expected on Friday.
At 0010 GMT, the key 225-share Nikkei average was up 219.46 points or 1.09 percent at 20,371.99. Its September futures were up 150 points at 20,400.
"The 20,000 should prove a firm floor for the Nikkei average today," a broker at a "Big Four" brokerage said. "How near it can get to 20,500 will be the point of interest today."
